_about: The Junior Classics: The Young Folks' Shelf of Books, edited by William Patten (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1912; the scans and Gutenberg texts are the 1918 printing). All ten volumes: 1-9 from Gutenberg, 10 (Poems Old and New, Reading Guides and Indexes) from the Internet Archive as raw OCR. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets.
